name: ATP (energy)
oneLine: The cell’s energy currency, shown as gold sparks.
howItWorks: Food is broken down to charge up ATP. Machines spend ATP to do work, like linking amino acids. No ATP, no work.
deeper: A growing bacterium spends millions of ATP every second. Most of it goes into building proteins.
sizeComparison: a 100,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Sparks are symbolic. ATP does not glow.
